lines: When the midnight bell dissolves into the night,
The queen of death reigns, deep in the forest.
Unable to even play as a mere jester,
Incomplete, empty, I wander uncertainly.
Kneel, and uncover the coffin,
Grasp that dried-up hand and kiss it.
People would call it immoral,
But, open your eyes, let your voice reach me,
In the curse of love.
Tonight, enchanted by the demon, let us dream (an irresistible, sweet dream);
I long to reach you (and take you away),
As fragrant memories rises.
Even your sunken eyes, your withered skin (burning desires and the stench of decay),
Are still lovely and dear,
As I call out your name, Roxanne.
Temptation, cruelty, the serpent of seduction,
Wrapped in thorns, it deceives and steals.
The [White Believers], unaware of themselves,
Scream for judgment, administering poison.
Only I could see it,
You simply loved everything too much.
Those who do not possess, would not tolerate it—
With just a glance, just a word,
You could take everything away.
If anger and hatred can bring you what you seek (even this sorrow is dear to me),
Those who brought harm (those worms),
I can crush them before your eyes.
The empty tomorrows are no longer needed   (turning away from the dazzling sunlight),
At our ball under the moon's shadow, let us waltz together!
In the midst of madness and your murderous intent (like a ritual, yes, like an offering),
I have become a broken doll (taking everything, even the sorrow)
Return it… forgive me… (even if we can't go back, I wish time could stand still)
In the echoing forest, darkness giggled softly (now, malice has chuckled)
Let us two—
Freeze our tears, and dream,
As I long to reach you (deep underground),
And there's nowhere to return to.
Even your sunken eyes, your withered skin (burning desires and the stench of decay),
Are still painfully lovely.
Take me away, Roxanne.

lines: The rose you touched
learned shame at its own form,
and will wither away in vain—
my finest masterpiece, my beloved girl.
Clad in a velvet dress,
a noble smile, within the castle of darkness,
the blood that moistens pale skin
lures you to the border of dream and reality.
I need no narrow gate of God;
what I want is a girl shining bewitchingly.
Becoming the goddess of slaughter,
I will fall into slavery.
Look—the doll's head goes rolling away,
bounding high down the dark staircase.
Papa taught me everything—
how to scoop it up,
and whether I'll sing it out in delight.
Ah, this mad love is brimming over,
a world where nothing is ever right.
I gave it all,
how to scoop it up,
and whether I'll sing it out in delight.
Deep within a distant consciousness
lie a blue sky and a gently blowing wind,
a garden where dazzling light blooms,
tears spill and trace down my cheeks—
what is this?
You need not think of anything at all,
just behave as your heart desires.
If someday you notice it was a sin,
you'll go mad, unable to move—won't you?
Look—a jet-black veil fills the room,
a sweet fragrance takes command of the body.
Papa carried everything away,
even the sorrowful memories,
even the crucifix of prayer.
Ah, behind a chained door,
tonight again I kindle demons and call a sacrifice.
I shall give you everything—
the roses that adorn your hair,
and the requiem of forgiveness too.
Clad in a velvet dress,
a noble smile, within the cage of darkness,
the blood that moistens pale skin
sets my heart to dancing.
I do not fear God's judgment;
what I want is a girl shining bewitchingly.
Becoming the goddess of slaughter,
I will fall into slavery.
Look—someone's head goes rolling away,
bounding high down the dark staircase.
Papa taught me everything—
how to scoop it up,
and whether I'll sing it out in delight.
Ah, this mad love is brimming over,
a world where nothing is ever right.
I gave it all,
how to scoop it up,
and whether I'll sing it out in delight.

lines: Ah, why was I ever born into this world—
when all of it is so unfair, and I can only live
clumsily, and barely at all…
Ah, the whispering demon says: “If it is light you want,
just seize it—with the strength of your own hands.”
The flower dwelling in my breast, if it feeds on sorrow and blooms,
within these frightened eyes a bewitching fire is mirrored.
From far away, someone's scream.
Blood streaming down my cheeks.
And you, crouched before my eyes.
If I could carve you like this for all eternity,
could I fall into pleasure even as I hate?
From inside my head, the droning cry of insects.
At the fingertips that sweep them away, a bewitching fire.
Ah, why am I even here?
If only someone had wanted me, I might have been saved.
The flower dwelling in my breast, if it feeds on sorrow and blooms,
in eyes that shine with joy, a bewitching fire blazes.
My torn-away heart writhes, warped and misshapen.

Kyrie eleison, alleluia

Telling, entrancing — the stage of death
a bittersweet past — ars moriendi
What repeats is the theater of death

a bottomless labyrinth of nostalgia for life
A requiem for kindred souls
Dance, whirl, go mad

lines: Who decided this — was it all arranged in advance?
Handed down from the distant past into now
Once, clad in light, it governed heaven and earth
A shard of miracle, spilled from the age of gods
Countless colors enfolding the earth
Showing the law that guides the world
White and black overlap and mark the passing of time
The elements that gather everywhere
Fulfill their mission and dwell in that place
The warmth of water and soil sustains all life
Suddenly it runs mad, appearing unnaturally
Warping scenery, distorting shapes
For what reason, and by whom,
From behind the layered folds of history
Were the threads made to be pulled?
A land once filled with freedom and knowledge
Ruined in a single night, returned to nothing — foolish greed
Countless colors dyeing the vast sky
Lay them side by side and the future stands before your eyes
A double helix of blue and crimson binds the ages
O brave and mighty warriors
Fix your eyes on the meaning of your birth and rise
Walk the path that wind and flame have pointed out
Something begins to break — an anxious dread comes creeping
Clouded sight, a trembling heart
Who hid the answer behind the secret door
And, leaving it locked, vanished into the dark?
The precious thing once surely loved —
Sacrificed even that to grasp it: only a fleeting gleam
Too far, too high to comprehend
The eternal beyond
Who decided this — was it all arranged in advance?
Handed down from the distant past into now
Once, clad in light, it governed heaven and earth
A shard of miracle, spilled from the age of gods

lines: A sigh and tears of honey, dragging a broken cocoon
On cold flagstones, the opened spine of a lamb-bound book
Dissolving into milk the nightmares scattered deep behind the eyelids
To the witch of ruin and harvest I prayed, and offered up everything
Within the poem I trace, is it the story now — or else…?
Do I live only to learn how it ends?
Beyond a wish that carries a prayer, not knowing what may lie there
Silver coins spilling down, simply returned to the earth
The girl with the broken neck sees nothing at all
Believing the wish fulfilled, she crossed herself and cast it away
I gathered the pale eyes and set them in a row
Burying a coffin of sweets in a glass miniature garden, gold thread stitched to the lashes
From the tip of a lost little finger, whose is the red that came unraveled?
The witch of ruin and harvest sneered, gazing over everything
"It's almost time — listen, you'll hear it soon, won't you"
When it swings down, the tone that tears apart turns to a scream
Beyond a swelling thought, not knowing what may lie there
A body spilling down, simply given back to the earth
The girl with the broken neck tells nothing at all
Believing this a dream, she crossed herself and cast it away
An illusion that can never be undone
Repeats, and goes on and on
Until death opens its eyes!
Beyond a swelling wish, not knowing what may lie there
Silver coins spilling down, simply returned to the earth
The girl with the broken neck sees nothing at all
Believing the wish fulfilled, she crossed herself and cast it away

Deep, shallow, strong — a whispering
that runs wild and echoes within me;
a wrought mirror of gold and silver,
night after night, praise and extol my beauty.
Everyone, look at me;
gazes swim across my skin,
a sigh spilling from red lips.
The witch's scheme is the apple's plot —
"I could let you have a taste, but... just kidding."
A single bite, and consciousness fades away;
let me teach that foolish witch a lesson.
"Mirror, mirror, who in all the world is the fairest of all?"
My madness — look — is whirling up;
I'll give you punishment until you're burned away.
The more you beg and plead, the more the dark aches out;
you'd best kneel down, upon the needle.
Grieving and sorrowing, the dwarves murmur:
"Please, dear prince, touch the princess."
Touching her white shoulder, he calls, pressing lips to hers;
from long lashes, blue eyes peer out.
Night after night, the witch who questions the mirror
rages madly, her breath all but failing,
muttering words of curse again and again,
bleeding through, she looks up at the night.
"Mirror, mirror, who in all the world is the most foolish of all?"
The witch's body — look — is squirming;
let me set a mark upon that ugly skin.
The more you beg and plead, the more the dark aches out;
a kiss upon the red-hot steel.
My madness is whirling up;
I'll give you punishment until you're burned away.
The more you beg and plead, the more the dark aches out;
you can never escape, for all eternity.
Deep, shallow, strong — a whispering
that goes on seeking within me.
A wrought mirror of gold and silver,
night after night, praise and extol my beauty.

In a castle sealed in mist, unknown to any soul,
three beautiful princesses dwell;
in the still night a tolling bell announces the feast's beginning,
and lured by a bewitching fragrance, pitiful offerings gather.
O chosen sacrifice of this night,
drown yourself in a sweet dream;
give up your all, and here within our arms
we shall grant you the highest pleasure —
offer up your untainted blood.
A demon-slayer who slipped into tonight's feast
has stirred awake the memories of when she lived as a human.
Devouring people, devouring time, she had set her heart aside;
though it should be a life lost together long, long ago,
there is no reason you should live, no chance we could meet,
and though I know it cannot be, my heart trembles still.
Long, long ago —
this is a tale of when she was still human.
The girl had someone she loved in return,
but the two were the son and daughter of rival noble houses;
they could never be allowed to be joined,
so with their deaths the two saw their love through.
Reborn as a demon,
before the girl who had passed thousands of years, the offering appeared —
the very likeness of her beloved,
a cruel trick of fate.
How foolish you are, our little sister —
to have your heart stolen by a mere human.
The meaning of blood that will not mingle with theirs —
surely you understand it.
Our blood becomes poison to humans;
if he wants it, then give him your blood.
O young Slusnik,
flee from this place at once;
if you say you cannot kill me,
then... let me protect you.
Through the dark forest, over frozen mountains, the two raced away,
seeking a far-off place where no one's eyes could reach;
for the two who betrayed their kin and betrayed humankind,
what waits is judgment — for we are Pandora's box…
The heart she reclaimed — it is the quickening of a beautiful life;
though I know it cannot be, my heart trembles still.
The two queens left behind vanished from sight,
and the demons' world fell into an age of war.
Meanwhile, the former queen who chose not to drink blood
lost her overwhelming power;
hunted now by both demons and humans,
yet rumor says she is guarded by two mighty demons of unknown identity.

In this reclining body, consciousness grows distant;
grating noise — I am falling.
Into the dark where I hold another self,
I learn a cruel pain, and tears spill over.
Counting the wounds that multiply, my grieving smile twists;
a spent, soundless wailing melts hollow into the dark.
Before I know it, I nestle close to a sweet Thanatos;
the nearer I draw, the deeper the wounds are gouged.
Instinct aching awake, a sweetly coloring voice,
a loveless tenderness — I fall, on and on, without end.
How many memories must I carve away?
Unable to resist, I give my body up to it.
The act of washing off defilement, meaningless, has warped;
no one will ever teach it — this is all of "me."
To live, to die — not even knowing which,
we overlap and melt away into the dark;
the glass I thrust into the lying grown-ups
casts back a false light and shatters.
To live, to die — not even able to choose,
a thing shared between two, vanishing fleetingly into the void;
my frozen heart refused to know,
for the world I was given is all there is.
Before I know it, I nestle close to a sweet Thanatos;
the nearer I draw, the deeper the wounds are gouged.
Instinct aching awake, a sweetly coloring voice,
a loveless tenderness — I fall, on and on, without end.

the thorn that serves up evil is a sweet, soft pain.
The holy sacrifices, a scheme to be reveled in;
fearing neither sin nor punishment, because you are here.
Bound together, we begin to go mad, and morality shatters too;
a distance where we cannot touch is fine — for I want to feel your heart.
Before highborn me, a servant kneels;

The desire everyone holds at the bottom of their heart
is just one, yes, only one:

Red lips, a Cantarella lurking within,

that person's mark upon my white skin —

Tonight, for whose sake —
love, sung as a lie;
a pure and proper lady
commits the forbidden.
Red lips, a Cantarella lurking within,
scattered over with fragments of purity;
that person's mark upon my white skin —
a forbidden love, but even so, it's fine.
Ah, there's no such thing as defilement between the two of us;
the scheming has begun its circling dance.
The secret key, and a sweet, soft past,
set to the timbre of a music box.
The brother who calls to me more than anyone is the only one;
hidden in the shadows of a moonlit night, we're drawn together.
If it's a thread I reeled in within the trap,
will I find joy in this passion, I wonder?
If the future can't be seen, then throw it away;
tears above all are the droplets that carry feeling.
Even if we cannot touch, if our eyes meet,
the warmth and meaning pass between us — so there's nothing to fear.
Tonight, in play,
let us fill it with lament;
a pure and proper lady
mingles blood and prays.

another me has fallen into sleep.

in nothing were we alike.

a beautiful voice — everything,
all that was given, was not given to me.
Behind sunken eyes, a shard of a shadow that twitches.
Let no one look upon this form of mine

is it a sin to wish to make it bloom?

lines: Twilight and stars, the door of night
Deep within the forbidden forest
a small voice announcing a beginning
repeats, “come this way”
Shall I give you sweet nectar?
Or shall I give you a red fruit?
If you moisten your parched throat
you fall — a hazy body and shadow
Take my hand, be lured, body swaying in the wind
Fingertips I set ringing, tangled in silver thread
From the pain in my back, golden wings pierce through
“It's all right if I can never go back”
A world without end
Into the clamoring dark of night
a small light
gathers into a flock and spins a crown of thorns
If it shines overhead in exchange for pain
the rust-colored droplets
will surely wet the petals
In a swaying labyrinth of longing
a single shard of a shattered past
offers up a dream, eerie yet beautiful
and, full of regret, sneers
If no one may ever touch me
if no one will ever love me
I wanted to forget it all
Please, make me a beast — ah
Worn-out feet and a torn dress
are being stained in my crimson
Each time the wings beat and bend, golden feathers tear away
whispering, “back to that day I long to return to,”
a transparent whispering voice
In the timbre being played
a smile of malice
Prayers go unanswered, voices do not reach
If you beg forgiveness in exchange for your heart
knowing neither sin nor punishment
only piling them ever higher
Within the forbidden feast
this body crumbling away
the soul turns into a flower
and is born in its true form
For eternity
Take my hand, be lured, body swaying in the wind
Fingertips I set ringing, tangled in silver thread
From the pain in my back, golden wings pierce through
“It's all right if I can never go back”
A world without end
Into the clamoring dark of night
a small light
gathers into a flock and spins a crown of thorns
If it shines overhead in exchange for pain
the ruling beast bows down
and the night will surely deepen

lines: Beyond the sky dyed in gold

Seeking the legendary dragon
a girl walks alone through the wasteland
For the sake of her sister laid low by illness
she wants his heart
Her toes split open, wet with blood
her throat runs dry, yet still she presses on
For the one dearer to her than anyone
would she kill another in her place?
The golden dragon cloaked in sorrow
brings chaos to the foolish legend
In the tower the girl finally reached
there was a beautiful youth
He offered her warm hospitality
and begged for tales of her long journey
Words exchanged, a gentle smile
the two lay their hearts together
She should have been used to being alone

For your sake, whom I forgive above all others
I want to show you my true form
but if you were to learn it now
you would weep with grief — what should I do?

Within your fading consciousness
your scream begins to ring out — do not cry
Embracing the memory of being loved above all
the girl set out across the ravaged land
awaiting the moment of the end
burning her finite life all the more fiercely

lines: Solitude gently gnaws at the human heart

Even though our fate can never be joined
Someday the day will come to scatter my life on a steel blade
I want to be broken by your hand

Clad in armor

I chase the shadow of the dark king
Even though our fate can never be joined
I want you to scatter me with that hand

lines: White-clasped fingers, a black iron cross
I offer to you, Mersophia
Silver rime — into the frozen, winter-withered forest
The echoing first cry was two: threads torn apart
That will never once cross and entwine
The decree of "Blanchene of Order" and "Noirte of Chaos"
Reeling in a secret bond, praying to the stars, I sleep and dream
Spilling shadows, beasts of the night, into the breathing world's silence
A young girl took my hand and spun it — the unmistakable hymn of god
No fate, not even the anguish of death, could cloud our vow
I simply believed, like the flower "iris" blooming and swaying all around
The severed petals, faint, and the sound of a bell that reaches
The beginning of the end — a scene I had watched sometime before
Never to be lost for all eternity
The decree of "Blanchene of Order" and "Noirte of Chaos"
Tracing the die that god cast, the star burns red and falls
Torn apart by sin, the human beasts, in the rondo of a cheating world

No fate, not even the anguish of death, could break this feeling
I still believed, like the flower "iris" blooming and swaying all around
Mersophia...
Even as searing flames scorched my body, I listened without looking away
"Your voice, your true voice" — the unmistakable hymn of god
No fate, not even the anguish of death, could break this feeling
Even now I believe, like the flower "iris" blooming and swaying all around
White-clasped fingers, a black iron cross
I offer to you, Mersophia
Where the world is bound, the defiled beast still nests and runs rampant
Ah, the flowers wither, and though your form turns to earth unseen
To the gentle hill of irises where we slept together…

lines: In the water, gazing up at the sky

Loved me
A shining star, the waning moon
Untouched by anyone, we melt together, don't we
With a shadow that floats in the mirage
The days of memory step a waltz
Reaching out a warm hand
A sorrowful face, beautiful eyes
To you, now, I will give a spell
A miracle to wind time back
Lighting the lamp's flame every night
Polishing my skin, stroking my hair
You kissed me
At the end of the ringing bell and the holy prayer
If eternity should somehow exist
I want it granted — for I need nothing else

Time passes — the thorns of a ruin

A shining star, the waning moon

You are here, and I fear nothing
The ringing bell trembles in the dark
Casting the two of us to the depths of the underworld
The wish, now granted, for all eternity
Fingers entwined, smiling eyes

Spreading transparent wings, eyes that gazed up at the sky — magic that heals the green
The secret you told softly to me alone
A phantom that passes down a thousand nights of dreams
A scarlet shard fallen from a billion glimmers of light
If someday I could find my way to where you are
Tell me the meaning and the heart of that gentle touch
Dip a dewdrop into a leaf and call the name
Press it to your eyelids and a world floats up
Foolish and greedy — will you laugh at me?
A faint thread, groped for and found, spinning the gap between human and demon
A single truth gives birth to a hundred more
Painted in my blood, here I shall inscribe the grimoire
A secret pleasure no one else need know
What I fiercely beg and crave is the scent you left behind
Even as my life is whittled away and the curse overflows
The unwithering spring of knowledge is the last gift you left me
A phantom that passes down a thousand nights of dreams
A scarlet shard fallen from a billion glimmers of light
If someday I could find my way to where you are
Tell me the meaning and the heart of that gentle touch
What I fiercely beg and crave is the scent you left behind
en.src: OCR draft — Shadows ～影色妖精絵本～

04.title: トリスタンと従士とイゾルデと侍女
flags: No furigana; proper nouns given directly in katakana and transliterated: フェイルノート=Failnaught, マビノギオン=Mabinogion, メロウ=merrow, リャナン・シー=Leanan Sídhe, シャムロック=Shamrock, プーカ=Púca, ブランジァン=Brangian, ゴルヴナル=Gorvenal, イゾルデ=Isolde, トリスタン=Tristan.
L4/L21: 運命 read 'unmei'; this artist sometimes sings 運命 as 'sadame' — flagged for audio check.
戀 = 恋 (koi); L58 眷恋 read 'kenren' (clinging attachment).
従士 read 'jijo' to match 侍女; both write 'jijo' here (booklet distinguishes them only by kanji).

lines: In the lapis-blue night sky, crossing over the sea, the moon's knight
Failnaught's arrow pierces through the heart of the sun's princess
A vow of fate, a silver ring creaking — Mabinogion
Stirring up an unforgiven longing, the merrow's song
Darkness, secretly; the star, fleetingly
Dreams, quietly; love, burning with yearning
Ah — in exchange for the heart
Prayer becomes a curse, the Leanan Sídhe's snare
A copper handmaid, a golden princess, a silver knight
The sorrow of thorns that will not bloom
The more you flee, the more you are caught
The dampened bud, so lustrous
Pour love into the holy grail
And drain the aphrodisiac of the snare
On Shamrock hill a clear sweeping wind races across the land
The one who steals the nation-saving princess is the enemy knight
The silver-white of fate, the turning gears — Mabinogion
Mocking the false feelings, the voice of the Púca
Reeling in desire, honey entwining
Heat, kissing, love — maddeningly
Ah — in exchange for life
The reward becomes rancor, the Leanan Sídhe's punishment
An iron squire, a silver knight, a golden princess
The rotting curse of thorns
The more you resist, the more you are taken
The piercing thorn — ah, so deep within
Fill the holy grail with love
The overflowing aphrodisiac of sin
Loving and serving the princess — Brangian
Yearning for the handmaid — Gorvenal
Falling, consumed with longing for the knight — Isolde
Stealing the princess from the king — Tristan
The black king, the golden princess, the silver knight
The withering scream of thorns
The more you flee, the more you are imprisoned
The rose that bloomed in madness is plucked and broken
The white princess, the silver knight, the golden princess
The falling tears of thorns
The more you drown, the more you are violated
What remains is the clinging love of betrayal
Steep life in the holy grail
The immoral aphrodisiac of death
en.src: OCR draft — Shadows ～影色妖精絵本～

05.title: Dark Night Fairy-finis
flags: No furigana. L18: 運命 read 'sadame' (no furigana; artist's usual sung reading) — flagged.

蝕む痛みが刺す
もう少し　あと少しと
黒びた肌を隠し羽を休めては
貴方へと笑いかける
呪いにも似た願い
一つの問いかけの中に在る
真実の感情を
隠しきれなくて貴方の頬に触れた
切なく　愛しい
明日には破れた羽を広げて
この街を出て行くと決めたから
美しい姿の記憶のまま
またねと呟き手を振るの

腐食した指の先に
金色の鱗粉が私を彩る

心の底では求めている
慈しんだその手を
哀しませたくないから逃げたのに
今、貴方を探して
空は燃えるような赤に染まり
街並み　揺れる影　刻む孤独
追イカケテ　追イカケナイデホシイ
相反する感情　裂ける
涙　懺悔と　闇の中
明日には破れた羽は朽ち果て
魂も蝕まれ消えるでしょう
美しい姿の記憶のまま
永遠に貴方と在りたい
涙　想いと　風になる

lines: Deep in a forest left standing dead
A secret door — the key is mine alone
Darkness crawling over my body, I am violated
A gnawing pain stabs through me
"Just a little more, a little longer"
Hiding my blackened skin, resting my wings
I smile toward you
A wish that resembles a curse
Within a single question there lies
A true feeling
Unable to hide it, I touched your cheek
Achingly, dearly
Tomorrow I will spread my torn wings
Because I have decided to leave this town
Keeping the memory of your beautiful form
"See you again," I murmur, and wave my hand
Even if it is a fate where we can never meet again
At the tips of my corroded fingers
Golden scale-dust colors me
You praised me, said that I was lovely
Your eyes rise up before me
In the depths of my heart I am longing
For that hand that cherished me
I fled because I did not want to make you grieve, and yet
Now I search for you
The sky is stained a burning red
Rows of houses, swaying shadows, carving out solitude
Chase after me — I want you not to chase after me
Contradictory feelings tear apart
Tears, repentance, within the darkness
Tomorrow my torn wings will rot away
And my soul, gnawed hollow, will surely vanish
Keeping the memory of your beautiful form
I want to be with you for eternity
Tears and longing become the wind
en.src: OCR draft — Shadows ～影色妖精絵本～

lines: "No matter what charm I try, I gain nothing,"
you murmur, sulking as if longing to be coddled
A picture-book you happened to glimpse, so very old
Its spells, like lies, leapt right and left
If you wish to touch the creatures
lurking in the dark, then come — beg greedily
It begins — the banquet of fools
Toward the sound of clapping hands, come, this way
The smiling illustration — a black light drifts softly down, and they laugh together
The magic that enchants in the moonlight seeks the voice a girl chants
Running about, frolicking to madness — call its name and it is yours to command
Good and evil both sit upon the same scale
A vain heart is merely set upon it and weighed
A little of this suffering, a little of this pain —
I want to adorn someone with them, like flowers
For the girl grown weary of her boredom
let me grant her lovely little wish
From within the breast I tore open
Roses come overflowing — gather them, scatter them
A world as ordinary as this does not suit a clever one like you
If you want to seek the truth, hurry and eat the honey I hold out
Amid sweet pleasure, a night of wavering — dream, or illusion?
Before you even notice the law you have stepped into, the night breaks into dawn
In the illustration, a dancing girl and a wicked beast are swaying
The magic that enchants in mischief seeks the voice a girl sings
Running about, frolicking, it vanished — seize everything, yours to command

lines: In your unmoving right hand, upon skin of steel
a single loneliness binds itself into the cracks
A dream once dreamed  a broken circuit
the shadow-play pattern of that day, seared in
Rubble and the dead  a silent town
Warped violet moon  cast down your light
Even now, still waiting wearily for the final hour
the memory of your touch  goes on dancing
Why does the herd of foolish weaklings sicken so
spending themselves in ruin, dying out
Born from the green forest  we return to the desert dust
No going back to that once-future  it drifts far away
A magic lantern  the prayers of saints and all
are things without any meaning at all
Dragging feet  a spilling spiral
clatters merrily down to the earth
Raindrops sliding down a twisted cheek
weep their gentle tears for me
If you made me on your own selfish whim
and loved me only as a passing fancy
then break the depths of this heart that learned pain
and quickly shatter me to pieces
In the "Pandora's box" that he held out
I alone remain, he mutters...
And so the foolish scientist's eyes sicken
spending themselves in ruin, and vanish
Ah  born from the green forest  we return to the desert dust
No going back to that once-future  it drifts far away
A magic lantern  the prayers of saints  are just excuses for madness
things without any meaning  and so all of it turns to nothing
en.src: OCR draft — -The Clockwork Rose- 時計仕掛けの薔薇少女

心を染めたくて 言葉を求めてる

Sagesumu you na shisen de
Kono mune wo tsuranuku
Sakihokoru hana ni mo kirei na tiara de mo
Watashi no naka wo mitasu koto wa kanawanai kitto
Kokoro wo sometakute kotoba wo motometeru
Aragawazu ni namae wo yonde
Motto watashi wo kizande
"Shinjitsu no ai nado shiri mo shinai akuma-domo ni

Furueru hada chi wo nagashite
Utsukushii obuje kawaii nakigoe
Koi wo oshie yume wo ataete
Ikiru imi wo kureta no wa
Yuiitsu no sonzai
Wakideru yokubou ni sunao ni shitagau no
Sore wa kami no michibiki da kara
To heta na iiwake
Doko made yogorereba itsu made kizutsukeba
Sono hohoemi wo misete kureru
Mada kotae wo shiranai
Tooi hitomi de kuchizusamu uta wa dare wo omotteru no
Koi wa kogare nikushimi wa mebuku no ne
Sakihokoru hana ni mo kirei na tiara de mo
Watashi no naka wo mitasu koto wa kanawanai kitto
Kokoro wo sometakute kotoba wo motometeru
Aragawazu ni namae wo yonde
Motto watashi wo kizande

When my eyes open again today, a fairy-tale world begins
Everyone wears a smile, singing the praises of love
If there's something they want, they chant that it's God's grace
If something stands in their way, they seize it with justice as their shield
A black prince who wandered in and lost his way,
stripped of his freedom, cast into a cold cell
Black hair and red eyes,
with a gaze as if in scorn,
pierce through this heart of mine
Not with flowers in full bloom, nor with a lovely tiara
can what is inside me be filled—surely not
Wanting to dye my heart, I keep seeking words
Without resisting, call my name
Carve yourself into me, more
"Upon the demons who know nothing of true love,
O wrath of the white god, come down as thunder"
Trembling skin, shedding blood
A beautiful objet, a sweet little cry
Teaching me love, granting me dreams—
the one who gave me a reason to live
was that sole existence
I honestly obey the desire that wells up
because it is God's guidance—
such a clumsy excuse
How far must I be soiled, how long must I wound,
before you show me that smile?
I still don't know the answer
The song you hum with distant eyes—whom are you thinking of?
Love yearns, and hatred buds, doesn't it
Not with flowers in full bloom, nor with a lovely tiara
can what is inside me be filled—surely not
Wanting to dye my heart, I keep seeking words
Without resisting, call my name
Carve yourself into me, more
Teach me pain

lines: Buried in mystery, in the silent sea of trees, a trace of glory: a slumbering fortress
Amid the ash left in the lantern, faintly glimmers the color of a jewel
Even after centuries, still standing proud, an unspoken pride
Loyalty once defied tyranny and left its words behind
If I only wished to wither away
(The flow of time draws close to solitude)
I should have found ease — and yet
I wish it fiercely: to inherit that grace, to pass beyond sorrow
Petals of a white-blooming soul; the tears that gently wet them are a sacred rain
That vow bound tight to my finger — to fulfill it, I keep on sleeping
And in time I awaken, toward eternity
The far-hazed castle of the sky; the wind of faith gathers and goes
To offer up a body ruled by original sin — is that blasphemy?
If the noble one, seeking meaning, walks the road by the guidance of proverbs
vividly it surfaces — the emblem of courage, lodged within the heart
An unseen far end, where rainbows pour down
(Where the stars are bound, the border of the horizon)
Repainting this world anew
Every longing, even the ideal scenery — a place where all can come true
Just as the prophecy written in ancient days foretold, the golden days come once more
The light I held deep in my chest overflows — a resounding song of miracles
And it fills to the brim, toward eternity
From valor toward blessing, the stage turns round
Touching the wings of the spirits, O shimmering word-soul
Petals of a white-blooming soul; the tears that gently wet them are a sacred rain
That vow bound tight to my finger — to fulfill it, I wake from sleep
Just as the prophecy written in ancient days foretold, the golden days come once more
The light I held deep in my chest overflows — a resounding song of miracles
And it fills to the brim, toward eternity

lines: Deep in the woods, when the secret door softly opens
the neighbor beats tiny wings and scatters malice around
Silver droplets trickle down, tracing along the trees
onto my skin, in mischief, they drip so cold
Tickling, just like that day
why was I the one left behind?
O white blizzard, rage and run wild
I am nothing but tears, holding my loneliness close
the eyes of the fairy king who has not yet come—
I let my heart race for them, going mad with longing
the needle of a curse that love gives birth to
Atop a little hill, the sound of those who dance and sing—
horn and bell, a fondly remembered ringing
An unseen form, a voice, the trace of a faint lingering scent
O black water, corrode it all
if it cannot become mine, then everything—
I wish it would just close away
yet no cry of mine will reach
Ah, what to do, what to do — even a nightmare would be fine
even torn to shreds, I would feel no regret
I want to chase it to the very end and seize it
until I break those golden wings …
I gently try to trace the mark carved into me
if it will vanish, then why does it rob me of oblivion?
O white blizzard, rage and run wild
I am nothing but tears, holding my loneliness close
the eyes of the fairy king who has not yet come—
I let my heart race for them, going mad with longing
I cannot forgive; I want to forgive
a writhing passion, a binding fence
if you would sneer that I am a fool
then give me the fruit of death

lines: Dreaming of jade, at the dawn I woke to

lines: An old picture book and a silver coin
a rusted knife, and a single strawberry
Little neighbor, what is it you like?
A girl draws it with wide, wide eyes
"No, don't — you'll call the darkness in"
the kitten nestles close, as if worried
chides me with its rough little tongue
and night comes again
That thing, laughing with malice in its hand,
hidden in the shadow of the bed, slipping unseen
[What it lacks is your blood — call out, call its name]
No matter how many times I try, is it no use?
The magic charm won't work
I want to make Mama, who's always angry, disappear—
is a wish like that not allowed?
"Never mind that — pet me instead"
the sleepy kitten nestles close
coaxing me with its little paws
and I grow warm
That thing, wearing a bored face,
hidden in the shadow of the door, unseen

"I'll protect you"
the hook-tailed kitten gave a sway

The thing that laughs with malice in its hand
melts black into the shadow of the bed
[What it wants is your blood — call out, call its name,
claws at your throat, waiting for the moment, someday …]

lines: In the dark, deep and shallow, I woke from sleep

Peering into the coffin, your eyes

The silver sword you held in one hand—
you must be wavering
Don't pierce me yet
the finger that strokes the blade's tip
touch it to my white skin
and let a crimson rose bloom
Bewildered, spellbound, you are mine
I'll teach you even the pleasure of being taken
Ah, you won't be honest

The dark is always pure

Don't pierce me yet
the finger that strokes the blade's tip

and let a crimson rose bloom
Bewildered, spellbound, you are mine
I'll teach you a life and a desire that never run dry

06.title: 炎恋

lines: 冷たい風が肌を裂くように撫でて
彼方へ消える
小高い丘に刺さる十字架
女たちは皆　白いドレス
縛られ　手足からは　滴る雫

もしも明日
貴方の手で攫ってくれたのなら ...
きっと　御伽噺のように幸せだと思えるはず
真実を知っても
憎しみ投げられた石つぶて
額を裂き地へ落ちる

The cold wind strokes my skin as though to tear it
And vanishes into the distance
A cross driven into a low hill
The women are all in white dresses
Bound, from their limbs the droplets drip
Reviled as a witch, my freedom torn away
If tomorrow
You would snatch me away with your own hand ...
Surely I could believe I was happy, like a fairy tale
Even were I to know the truth
Stones flung in hatred

You who had blended into the crowd

With nowhere to go, the hatred races through me

Bound, from my knees the flames leap and dance
Reviled as a witch, my freedom torn away
If tomorrow

Surely I could believe I was happy, like a fairy tale

Robbed still by lies and by longing
